title: VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.00384v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Fitting quantitative models to data is a central step in scientific workflows, yet it remains one of the least automated. Recent agent-based systems leverage language and vision-language models (VLMs) to propose statistical models, but these systems struggle on challenging modeling tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce VESTA (Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents), a framework that equips VLMs with a dynamically growing toolkit to guide model refinement through data transformations, hypothesis-driven visualizations, and statistical tests. Unlike prior systems that rely on iterative critique alone, VESTA explores data before and during refinement by selecting or creating reusable diagnostic tools. We evaluate VESTA using three toolkit configurations: no tools, static expert-written tools, and dynamic model-written tools. translated_title: VESTA：基于统计工具智能体的可视化探索
translated_abstract: 将定量模型拟合到数据是科学工作流程中的核心步骤，但这一步骤仍然是自动化程度最低的环节之一。近年来，基于智能体的系统利用语言模型和视觉语言模型（VLM）来提出统计模型，但这些系统在具有挑战性的建模任务上表现不佳。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了VESTA（Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents，基于统计工具智能体的可视化探索），这是一个为VLM配备动态增长工具包的框架，通过数据变换、假设驱动的可视化以及统计检验来引导模型的改进。与以往仅依赖迭代式批评反馈的系统不同，VESTA通过选择或创建可复用的诊断工具，在模型改进之前和改进过程中对数据进行探索。我们使用三种工具包配置对VESTA进行评估：无工具、静态的专家编写工具，以及动态的模型自建工具。为支持这一评估，我们引入了DAWN（用于自动化工作流程和数值……的数据集）——摘要在此处截断。
tldr: VESTA是一个为视觉语言模型配备动态增长工具包的新框架，通过数据变换、假设驱动的可视化和统计检验来探索数据并改进统计建模，克服了以往仅依赖迭代批评的智能体系统在复杂建模任务上的局限。
en_tdlr: VESTA is a framework that equips VLMs with a dynamically growing toolkit to explore data through transformations, hypothesis-driven visualizations, and statistical tests, enabling more robust statistical model refinement than prior systems relying solely on iterative critique.
